title: Turn text into bytes and count unknown words
brief: Write the byte encoder and decoder that make every text representable, and measure how many words a fixed word list misses.
hints: text_to_bytes is list(text.encode('utf-8')). An accented letter gives two numbers and an emoji gives four, so the list can be longer than the string.
bytes_to_text is bytes(ids).decode('utf-8'). Decode the whole list at once, never one id at a time.
unknown_rate splits the text with text.split(), counts the words that are not in word_vocab, and divides by the number of words. Return 0.0 when there are no words.
